notes.title: Hotfix #5 | Out Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Guardians...

Hotfix #5 is here! Following this update, as our next announcement, we’ll be unveiling some exciting news we’ve been eager to share - something we think you’ll be just as thrilled about as we are. Although we cannot share what it is just yet, here's all the things that will be rolling out with the hotfix!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/16f60813eb54ec8a60eeacb149da4d610e946af5.png"]
By popular request, Procedurally Clams spawn more frequently. Visit sandy and graveling areas near ocean!

Clam Crystals (Pearls) are worth much less. 

Small chance to find buried chest when digging up clams. 

Red Fox Classic character skin can now be discovered in game. After completing small puzzle. 

Misc Landscape sculpting fixes. 

Misc misaligned props and foliage fixes. 

Portal Menu UI hover effect fix. 

By popular request, Map Fog is now completely removed if player unlocks all obelisks. 

White Raven in player homes optimized. (Anim tick paused when out of range.) 

New Accessibility Option. Camera Shake slider. Allows players to manually adjust Camera Shake intensity in game. Can be set to 0. WIP, does not yet effect all boss attacks. 

Characters that use common turtle class (Light Weaver and Loot Tortoise) optimization fixes. Should now pause anim tick, disable cast shadows, and disable movement when out of range. Logic is now shared between all common turtle sub classes. 

Credits Updated 

Character skin that was unintentionally in game removed.

Trying to Hide Pins on Map no longer crashes game. 

Added collision to a few props that were missing it. 

Game now performs audit of save data and will remove SaveAFox exclusive skins if player doesn't own this DLC.

Target Jump no longer causes camera to extend and clip through walls and floors. This bug was introduced just before launch, terribly sorry! 

New Scroll Category for scrolls not belonging to any major tribe. For future updates. 

Tooltip widget optimized and various other UI optimizations. 

Small cursor change to prevent it disappearing. 

Change to F11 behaviour to prevent it from causing cursor to be offset.

F11 now uses Fullscreen Borderless 

Announcement Panel on main menu can now show multiple images in gallery. 

Rollback Save feature now closes modules when executed. 

Misc Translation fixes. 

Hlods update 

Nav Mesh updated 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/67a210fa6a12f208f427a12dc73479adc78fd45d.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"]



If you'd like to share your feedback & help us keep improving the game, please join our community Discord.   Many thanks to everyone once again for contributing and being a part of this wonderful community! And, as promised, we will see you VERY soon with even more exciting news! 

Infuse Studio & Silver Lining Interactive

notes.title: Hotfix #4 | Mikayla Memorial
notes.notes:
Greetings, Guardians,

Today, we are introducing Hotfix #4. which brings with it a number of improvements, patches & bug fixes, details of which you can find below. But above all, this update introduces something far more important and close to our hearts: a permanent in-game memorial to Mikayla Raines.

[previewyoutube="vd15cduYUPY;full"][/previewyoutube]
Mikayla was the founder of SaveAFox Rescue, a passionate animal caretaker, and a gentle force for good in the lives of countless foxes, and people. We have had the opportunity to collaborate together on some upcoming news for Spirit Of The North 2, and we are fully committed to continue supporting SaveAFox in the coming months and years. We hope this memorial will be a place where you can peacefully, and respectfully remember Mikayla and her legacy.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"]
A Place to Remember
Nestled in a quiet corner of Fox Village, you will now find a new area dedicated to Mikayla’s memory. At its centre stands a newly-implemented mural of Namara, a character from the world of Spirit of the North 2 inspired by Mikayla herself.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/c7fdb743fe62ca81281be7fc2d0de4154bd47313.jpg"]

Namara’s name means “No Sorrow” or “The One Who Dispels Sorrow.” In the game’s lore, she was a gentle caretaker of animals whose home was a flourishing garden full of life - especially foxes. Her kindness, and deep compassion made her beloved by all creatures.

You may also notice Finnegan, a small fox who hangs out near the mural, never straying far from Namara’s side. He is always there, resting by her side.

Although we never knew Mikayla personally, this is how we choose to remember her: as someone who left beauty and joy in her wake. This memorial is our small way of honouring her. We hope it brings warmth to those who knew her, followed her, or were touched by her spirit.

Thank you for sharing this world with us. And thank you, Mikayla, for helping make it kinder. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/8b53568c12ceeac13cac97e6c33f4ed82ac0fe76.jpg"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"]
Patch Notes
SaveAFox tribute area added to Fox Island. Featuring a memorial to Mikayla Raines. 

SaveAFox logo updated in credits.

SaveAFox Finnegan NPC added to tribute area.



QOL UPDATES
Sprint Toggle can now be enabled in settings. When enabled, player can sprint by toggling sprint on and off rather than by holding.

Water Rune Improvements. We felt the Water Rune was underwhelming and gave it a new fun mechanic.  When rune is equipped the player character can jump while in water. Can be used for jumping across water surface or to more easily exit water. Jumping in water uses 1 spirit energy. Water rune swim speed buff decreased from x2 to x1.6. Water Geysers restore spirit energy(unchanged).

40+ Statues of Eona added through out world in an effort to reduce time spent walking back to graves. 

Vixen Skin added to game with small platforming challenge.



GAMEPLAY & UI BUG FIXES
Custom drop down menu added instead of menu anchors so scrolls boxes work properly within settings menu.  In preparation to add more settings over the years.

Player character can no longer bring lit torch into Stag Guardian Encounter.

Player character can no longer carry items into final Grimnir Encounter. Will auto drop when cutscene begins.

Waypoint no longer spawns in ending level.

Various bug fixes for Palace of Peace.

Player can no longer enter Stag Temple from top to access Spirit Form rune early.

Loot Tortoise Improvements. Mushroom trails are not so far away, spawn on surfaces that can be reached, and mushrooms are evenly spaced along path to follow.  Loot tortoise should now always spawn in Mushroom ring.

Base Rejuvination (Regaining spirit energy) is now paused while using Spirit Form Abilities.  This change also prevent buffs to rejuvenation from exceeding Spirit Energy drain from Spirit Form.  No more infinite Spirit Form when comboing Spirit Form with Rune of Suffering.

Rotation bug after closing pause menu. Fixed!

Improvements to Target Jump. Blocking volumes now more efficiently stop traces and no longer produce invalid targets.

Character friction settings are properly applied when moving from Ice to Grey Sand(Very specific I know... lets celebrate). Fixes issue where fox would continue to slide after exiting ice slides.

Spirit Form Bug Fix. When returning from spirit form to a "ragdolled" body (because of death or being struck by something) body will remain in ragdoll until recovery or respawn. Returning to dead body will no longer cause the body to play "wake-up" animation.

Spirit Form Bug Fix. Controls are no longer locked when body is "ragdolled"  while player is in spirit form.

Spirit Form Bug Fix. Spirit form no longer experiences strange movement and rotation issues when body is "ragdolled".

Ram Boss melee attack range and melee trigger range are equal. Ram will no longer get stuck in endless melee attacks if player is nearby but out of damage range.

Stationary Stone Torches now properly deactivate Moon Runes when lit.

Fixed container that was missing loot. New drop location for Water Rune.

 
OPTIMIZATIONS
Continued environment optimization. Removed foliage hidden under static meshes.

Rebuilt HLODs.

Rebuilt Nav mesh.


ENVIRONMENT & LEVEL FIXES
Continued environment polish. Fixed various misalign geometry.

Collision fixed for particular river.

Replaced problematic cliff mesh throughout world.

Loot added to a few locations that were missing loot containers.

More environment clean up. (floating rocks, misaligned cliff mesh edges, etc)

Jump Targets block around player home mirrors.

Foxy Home doors now auto open from both sides.

Free portals (like those in glacier tunnels) now handle more edge cases. Fixed bug that caused player to teleport to wrong location OOB if player target jumped through portal. Also added fade to black for smoother transitions.

Misc Environment meshing fixes. Near Thief's Demise.

Decorative torches will now ignite flammable items(like held torches) but not player character. These torches are also no longer jump targets.


VISUAL POLISH
Waterfalls no longer causes fox to bubble from mouth.

Crossfox skin color and saturation adjustments.

High Global Illumination now correctly impacts performance.

Furless Fox Bug. Fixed issues that caused character fur to be hidden but skin visible when returning from Spirit Form while camera is close to character and materials are faded.

Misc VFX optimization  


AUDIO POLISH
Optimization for footstep VFX.

UI Pause Menu Open SFX now aligns with player input.

Rune Ability Wisp Form now has SFX

Rune Ability Wisp Form now allows player to "chirp" like a wisp

Player Wisp Form chirp SFX updated. Now uses sound from SOTN1.

Player Wisp Form listener location updated(Can hear things near wisp instead of near fox.)



MISC CHANGES
Updates to Announcement Panel in Main Menu.

Framework for accessing announcement data from website (Work in Progress).

Framework for future DLC implementation completed (All platforms).

Credits removed from main menu in preparation for addition UI features.

Translation changes for Sun Wolf name in several languages including English. Was Okama and now is Okamu.  Many languages already used this alternative spelling to avoid association with a Japanese slur.

Water Rune description updated for all languages.

Misc typo fixes in various languages like Spanish and Russian.

Added Translation for recent UI additions such as "Enable Toggle Sprint".
 
CONSOLE UPDATES
Coming very soon


Thank you once more. With love,

Infuse Studio & Silver Lining Interactive

notes.title: Hotfix #3 | Month 1 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Guardians,
Thank you for you patience and ongoing feedback. We’ve been listening closely, reading every report, and working hard behind the scenes to deliver a more stable, immersive, and beautifully optimized experience. Today, we’re rolling out Hotfix #3 the Month 1 Update - live now!

Here’s what’s included!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"]🔄 SAVE SYSTEM UPDATES
Backup Save System: The game now automatically creates a backup save every 25 minutes (max 10 backups). You can rollback to these if your main save is corrupted or soft-locked. Access this via Manage Save Data menu.

Save Game Naming: Simplified save file names (no special characters); Names are shorter to fix issues caused by file names becoming to long for some devices.

Save Name Auditing: Long or invalid save names are now automatically corrected to conform to new system.

Save Copy Fixes: Copying an original save multiple times during different play sessions no long causes new copies to overwrite existing copies. New save names are now unique.

Offline Achievements: Now properly tracked.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/09f2fbd6354ca8c9dda54f9492f31ff1ddeeb4a0.jpg"]


💆 QOL UPDATES
Keybinds on PC: "M" opens map, "Esc" opens Exit Menu. "Tab" still returns to your last visited tab.

Panning Map: Smoother and no longer clamped.


🕹️ GAMEPLAY & UI BUG FIXES
D-Pad Input Adjustments: D-pad up/down are no longer zooms the camera as these inputs are mapped to Fat Travel Home and Photomode. Zooming remains a PC-only feature (mouse wheel).

Pressure Plate Fixes: Now reset properly if associated objects despawn or reset, fixing several soft-lock issues.

Lava River Platforms: now spawn properly when you load game already in proximity.

Destructible Ram Door: Now retains its broken state after being destroyed.

Stormy Home Key Fix: No longer unlocked by unlocking Stormvale Portal.

Tomb of Heilda: Stone elevator fixed.

Ashlands Snake Shrine: puzzles fixed.

Statue of Eona in Fox Island Cave: No longer overrides Home location when activated if main story is completed.

Map Waypoint Fix: Waypoints now correctly place on grave icons.

Scroll Pop-up: Scroll count display fixed.


🔧 OPTIMIZATIONS
Reflection Quality Fix (Low Settings): PC visuals now look as intended. Low settings can now enjoy better visuals with no performance impact.

Adjust World Position Offset Disable Distance 100s of game actors (Hazel Bushes, various plague meshes, flags, etc). These actors would invalidate shadow cache a extreme distances.

Static mobility now applied to non-moving components (chests base, door frames, standing stones, etc.). Prevents Shadow cache invalidation.

Static mobility now applied to non-moving actors (Destructible pottery, Audio/trigger/blocking volumes, VFX, Spline paths (wisps, rivers, slides),Flag poles, hero skeletons, etc, etc). Actor that need mobility override this. Prevents Shadow cache invalidation.

Rogue and hidden foliage cleaned up to improve performance.


🌿 ENVIRONMENT & LEVEL FIXES
Trial of Elders, City of Mosswood, Ashlands Snake Shrine, Mulfara Falls, Fox Village, and more cleaned up.

Glide Cavern: Collision and mesh fixes.

Pine Forest Rock and other Misc Meshes: Now has proper collision.

Player home misc fixes.

Skylight and Dungeon Hole Fixes: Closed off areas accessible via late-game abilities.


✨ VISUAL POLISH 
Unique NPC Foxes: No more unintended tail glow during the burning village scene.

Grimnir Encounter Visuals: Light particles and FX improved.

Spirit Antlers & Fox Tail Embers: Now match your Light Essence colour for better visual consistency.

Thorned Plague Vine Attacks: Now respond visually to Thorn Walker Rune.


🎵 AUDIO POLISH
Various music stinger and layers that were broken on PC are fixed. This include "Kulning" vocals in Misthaven.

Mossy Home Portal & Outro Music polish.

Volume Slider SFX: Now affects raccoon and tortoise sounds.

Console Music Bug: Fixed audio cutting in and out.

Game Ending: Footstep SFX fixed.


⚔️ GRIMNIR ENCOUNTER BALANCING
General

Grimnir's plague projectile cooldown increased (2.5s → 4s).

Knockback reduced by 50% and removed during dashes and targeted jumps.

Ram Phase:

Grimnir's Melee cooldown increased to 4s.

Lightning visuals now match Cleansed Ram.

Grimnir's Plague "Cage" resized and given a visual upgrade.

Sun Wolf Phase

Roots now deal only Thorn damage and no longer cause rapid multiple hits.

Knockback behaviour adjusted.

Moon Wolf Phase

Platforms now appear when gliding or walking underneath with Sunken Rune.

Bear Phase

9 fireflies instead of 3. Platforming redesigned to be a recovery/breather phase.


🐾 MISC CHANGES
Special Main Menu: Look for changes during the Light Weaver Event. 🦝

Stag Temple Gate: Spirit vines now activate after unlocking Spirit Form Rune.  This help guide player to use Spirit Form and progress in this area before leaving.

Glide Cavern: Slight redesign to better guide player at start.

Light Essence Icons & Descriptions: Updated to better reflect lore and Guardian themes.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/51074ca09057090b08340356f0b7b33837bbc5c6.png"]



If you'd like to participate and help this game continue to become better, please join our active community on Discord. Many thanks to everyone who’s sending in bug reports, sharing feedback, participating in discussions, and supporting our journey. Your continued love for Spirit of the North 2 helps us make the experience better for everyone! 

Stay tuned for more updates; and we’ll see you in the glades, on the cliffs, and beneath the stars. 🦊✨ 

Infuse Studio & Silver Lining Interactive

notes.title: Hotfix #2 | Week 2 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Guardians! 🦊 

We’re excited to share that Hotfix #1.3, CL 12895, now live on PC, with the console update arriving in just a few days! This patch brings a host of important fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and community-requested changes. Let’s dive in:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png
🔧List of fixes
 Collection Removed At End Of Game.  Fixed issue that caused players to lose their collection(Relics and Keys) after finishing game if they died before reaching a Statue of Eona.
Save Game Repair. We implemented a script that audits and repairs your save file that runs automatically when you select a save game to play.  Currently this includes fixes for those who's Relics and Keys were deleted at the end of their game. The game will re-add them when you relaunch your save game. This script also attempts to re-add your Raven companion if you have a Glide Rune but no Raven.
Landscape and Cliff meshing around Misthaven Northern gate.  Waterfall and pond added to prevent players from accessing Highlands with a torch.
Jump Gate in North Misthaven now uses standing stone for activation(requires spirit form). 
Stag Temple now traps player inside to force them to use Spirit Form.  Many players were obtaining Spirit Form and just leaving. 
Progress Lost issue #1.  The Ram Encounter would continue to block autosave if the player abandoned it.  This lead to player losing progress if they continued to play for a long time and then dying.
Progress Lost issues #2.  Some puzzle involving hiding wisps and cutscenes would not stop blocking autosaves. This lead to player losing progress if they continued to play for a long time and then dying.
Removed rogue lever in front of Bear Guardian Temple.
Various fixes to Fox Island behavior and appearance when returning after end of game. ie Killbox under wooden bridge will not be present. Also plugged hole leading to portion of cave that is intended to be inaccessible.
Lighting changes for Lumen on Xbox Series S
Mosswood Foliage Cleanup.
Added ext triggers for some Stormvale structures.
Internet Time Events now uses our own website.  This should fix the issue of events like the Light Weaver not being blocked in countries like Russia. We will continue to test and work on this and thank you for you ongoing patience.
Added Bear Roar SFX to end encounter.
Added missing lava SFX
Misc fixes for environment holes and and misaligned meshes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png

Thank you all for your continued feedback and support for our small team. Your reports and suggestions help make Spirit Of The North 2 the best it can be. As always, we’ll be keeping an eye out for your thoughts and suggestions!


Infuse Studio & The Silver Lining Interactive Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/6107c7f8e20e0d28bb7bbc0ab7e594e5b0095cd0.png

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Greetings Guardians! 

Thank you so much for all the support and kindness you've shown our small team in the first week of our game's launch - we're overwhelmed with the amount of support! You've been incredibly helpful by sharing the bugs and issues you've encountered. 

There are still issues to address and it's likely others will pop up, the five of us are quickly looking to address what we can by importance and volume and we've been hard at work implementing a number of fixes to issues you, our community highlighted. These include;

Gameplay changes & fixes

 We've added a Wisp after the glide cavern, to help guide the player towards Mosswood
 In the Sunfire passage, the door that requires pressure plates, now requires rope pulls to open it, allowing players to backtrack if they want
 The Raven logic has been updated. Now, Thought the Raven will return to you even if you choose not to follow her directions
 Murals now ignite regardless of Thought being with you or not. Now murals will always be lit, so you don't miss then on the change Thought has gone on her own little adventure..
 Tweaks to the Sunfire passage to make the area more consistent and streamlined
 The Guardian Intro Cutscenes now only play once per gameplay session
 Added an additional condition for Thought joining you, fixing for players who managed to miss her
 Dropped Items now disappear after 3 minutes instead of 2
 The Raccoon Cleanup Crew will hold items for a full 10 seconds before taking it (instead of 5), giving the player more time to react
 Bite damage is no longer prevented by equipping the Thorn Walker Rune
 Wisp form can no longer be used to bypass the Sea Monster, AKA Gerald
 Wisp form can no longer be used to prevent damage to fox body
 Fixes to Ashlands Snake Shrine puzzle making it more consistent



Environment changes & fixes

 Fixed trap holes in Stormvale Tower that players can fall down and get stuck inside
 Ashland Racoon Grotto collision bug fixes
 Fox Island foliage bug fixes
 Raven Temple trap holes collision fixes
 Sign posts added before and after glide cavern to help guide player
 Tree trunk collisions updated, so foxes are no longer stuck in trees..
 Stormvale cliff meshing around Ram Temple updated to keep players from climbing up to the top before returning the Relics
 We've added numerous blockers for player graves in dungeons, so that the graves will no longer spawn at the bottom of inaccessible pits and instead, close to the last spot they fell from
 Performance Issues near player home mirrors fixed
 Forest Tower collision fixes
 Blockers added to Misthaven to keep players from leaving before cleansing Memory



Audio

 Re-exported Major Guardian cutscenes in better quality
 Added a new sound effects to 'evil' associated puzzles
 Fix for Final guardian pre-fight music not triggering
 Fix for Fox vocalizations not playing in corrupted zones
 Further memory optimization, more music now streams
 Added Tribe layer of audio to Raven Temple and Seer’s Crypt
 Added SFX to burning trees in Ashland
 Added Vista music changes
 Added Puzzle Complete sound effects to all Biomes
 Guardian 3&4 Cutscene audio now plays correctly on multiple encounter attempts
 Glacier music now plays correctly
 Glacier sound effects tweaks
 Added Glide sound effects
 Whimper SFXs tweaked
 Added Outro for final guardian Encounter
 Added SFX to a phase of the final guardian  Encounter


Console Specific
*Console fixes will go live in the next 10 working days.
Global Illumination issues have been addressed, resolving excessive darkness in underground areas. Lighting quality in these areas is now comparable to the PC version
Fixed camera jitter. Camera movement over uneven surfaces/collisions now matches PC behaviour

Screenshot credits: KAT  - go show them some love!

From us at Infuse and Silver Lining, thankyou so much again for your support.

notes.title: Spirit of the North 2 Development Update.
notes.notes:
Hello folks,

Spirit of the North 2 is mere days away and we’re beyond excited for you to immerse yourselves in this atmospheric adventure about Fox and their Raven companion. As we near ever closer to SOTN2’s release we wanted to address the experiences many of you had with the demo that was released last year. 

First off, we want to say a genuine and heartfelt thank you to everyone who shared their feedback and critiques. Not only was the feedback valid and invaluable, the sheer volume of separate Discussion threads and associated comments reiterated to us how much love you all have for our game and your anticipation for the next instalment. 

While we didn’t respond to you all directly, the Infuse team did write about the SOTN 2’s demo, optimization, origins, impacts of using UE5 during its Beta phase while simultaneously developing a new game and the goals for SOTN 2 as a whole. All of which you can read here.

To continue with our goal of transparent communication we want to give you more information and context about what the team at Infuse have been working on since the SOTN 2 demo originally launched and how this work will prevent many of the challenges you experienced in the demo happening in the full game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/e557538e3ca3b72e0465752ae35809e06a91b284.jpg

Optimization
The last months of 2024 were spent solely on optimisation. Everything from weather, the in-game day/night cycle to UI and menu performance, has all been looked at to try and squeeze every last frame out of the game to make it as smooth an experience as possible. 

Onboarding
There have been changes to the opening portions of the game when it comes to player onboarding. As a semi open world game with vast areas to explore, it was important to find the right balance between not showing players a dotted path in front to follow whilst also not making them feel lost with no sense of direction.
 
With the help of things like Red Smoke trails guiding players to all major dungeon locations (a feature call-back to the original Spirit of the North), you are able to explore the beauty and wonder of the world until your hearts content knowing that all you need to do is look for these Red Smoke Trails to instantly get back on track. This, along with other tweaks in the opening level have been designed specifically to show mini examples of SOTN 2’s gameplay loop players will experience once they are let loose into the world.

Story and Cutscenes
It's important to make players care about the journey they are undertaking and to care about the relationship between the fox and the raven as you help each other navigate a vast world. By far the most important way is to finalise and add in fully rendered in-engine cutscenes as well as beautifully hand drawn ones that appear during each Guardian encounter.

More Optimisation!
More recently we have done extensive compatibility testing to try and make sure we can recommend the minimum and also best suited specs for the game. As an Unreal Engine 5 title, it will need a powerful rig to see it in all its beauty but we've tried to make it as accessible as possible to players that don't have super up to date machines. There are extensive settings to tweak to your liking and even on low settings, still is a sight to behold.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/bd91cdc97198522f9525b8cc7227dac15c3d79e9.jpg

We understand that everyone may not have access to the hardware required to run this game. The minimum and recommended specifications are listed on SOTN 2’s store page and we’ve also included them below. We want to ensure as much as possible that everyone can make as much of an informed decision as possible when it comes to purchasing our game.

Minimum:

 Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
 OS: 64 bit Windows 10/11
 Processor: 12th Gen Intel Core i7-12700K or equivalent
 Memory: 16 GB RAM
 Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 / Radeon RX 6800
 DirectX: Version 12
 Storage: 25 GB available space

Additional Notes: Resolution: 1920x1080 Native, FPS: 30, Graphics Setting Preset: Low

Recommended:

 Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
 OS: 64 bit Windows 10/11
 Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X / Intel Core i7-12700K or equivalent
 Memory: 16 GB RAM
 Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 / Radeon RX 7800 XT
 DirectX: Version 12
 Storage: 25 GB available space

Additional Notes: Resolution: 1920x1080 Native, FPS: 60, Graphics Setting Preset: High

We hope this information and context gives you some assurance to the quality of the game we’re making. Thank you so much to our community, old and new, for the level of support you’ve shown the developers, Infuse Studio and Spirit of the North 1 & 2. We’re humbled by your support. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1778840/Spirit_of_the_North_2/

See you in the wilderness!
Silver Lining Int and Infuse Studio

notes.title: Spirit Of The North 2 | Release Date Announcement

Greetings, Guardians!

We know it's been a long wait, but we're finally thrilled to announce that Spirit of the North 2 will be releasing on the 8th May 2025.

As we’ve built this world, we’ve often wondered—what paths will you take? What hidden secrets will you uncover first? Will you forge ahead boldly, or take your time to explore every inch of this ancient land? However you choose to play, we cannot wait for you to experience it for yourself.
